Class MouseClickedEventAdapter

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.eventadapter.MouseClickedEventAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class MouseClickedEventAdapter extends Object implements EventAdapter
Event adapter class for mouse clicked events.
